texts.value: Receptor for angiotensin II, a vasoconstricting peptide (PubMed:28379944, PubMed:29967536, PubMed:31899086, PubMed:8185599). Primarily signals via a non-canonical G protein- and beta-arrestin independent pathways (PubMed:28379944). Cooperates with MTUS1 to inhibit ERK2 activation and cell proliferation (PubMed:15123706)
